$Comment: MMO Skill Tree's half of the Hallowed set, Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json. Joins adds this file to that
set instead of making a set of its own, so the player still sees one Hallowed set: one notice,
one entry, one look. The set's name, members and look stay that file's, so this file names none.
Its one tier asks exactly what the set's tier asks, a Jack Helm worn and a Jack Shield in the
utility slot (Armor 1 and Utility 1), so it joins that tier: its stats apply beside the set's,
and its line follows the set's line in the same notice. A tier asking for something else would
be added as a tier of its own. Requires takes this file out on a server without MMO Skill Tree,
where these stats do not exist and its line would name a bonus nobody gets; always write it with
MMO_Luck takes whole percent points (5 is 5%), the luck every skill's lucky rolls read.
MMO_DamageFlat_ARTILLERY adds raw damage to a hit while an Artillery weapon is in hand when it
lands, which for a Lantern Bomb means another bomb still in hand. Both are Additive on purpose:
these channels have a base of zero, so a Multiplicative entry computes nothing.
